description.en: A Greek-ruled Hellenistic state founded by Seleucus I from Alexander's conquests. At its height it stretched from Anatolia to Afghanistan. It lost the east to Parthia and Bactria, Anatolia to Rome, and ended when Pompey made Syria a Roman province.
description.es: Un estado helenístico de gobierno griego fundado por Seleuco I a partir de las conquistas de Alejandro. En su apogeo se extendía desde Anatolia hasta Afganistán. Perdió el este ante Partia y Bactria, Anatolia ante Roma, y terminó cuando Pompeyo convirtió Siria en provincia romana.
description.zh: 由塞琉古一世在亚历山大征服地基础上建立的希腊化国家，由希腊人统治。鼎盛时疆域东西横跨安纳托利亚至阿富汗。它的东部被帕提亚和巴克特里亚夺走，安纳托利亚被罗马夺走，最终因庞培将叙利亚设为罗马行省而灭亡。

sources.citation: The Land of the Elephant Kings: Space, Territory, and Ideology in the Seleucid Empire (2018), via PeriodO: "Seleucid Empire" (311 – 64 BCE).
Toumanoff, Cyrille (1963). Studies in Christian Caucasian History, via PeriodO: "Seleucid Monarchy" (301 – 84 BC).

note.en: The start runs from Seleucus I's takeover of Babylon in 312/311 BCE to 301 BCE, the date Toumanoff gives for the monarchy. The end runs from 84/83 BCE, when Tigranes of Armenia took Syria, to 64/63 BCE, when Pompey made Syria a Roman province.
note.es: El inicio va desde la toma de Babilonia por Seleuco I en 312/311 a. e. c. hasta 301 a. e. c., fecha que da Toumanoff para la monarquía. El final va de 84/83 a. e. c., cuando Tigranes de Armenia tomó Siria, a 64/63 a. e. c., cuando Pompeyo convirtió Siria en provincia romana.
note.zh: 起点从塞琉古一世于公元前312/311年夺取巴比伦，到公元前301年（图马诺夫给出的王国开端）。终点从公元前84/83年亚美尼亚的提格兰夺取叙利亚，一直到公元前64/63年庞培将叙利亚设为罗马行省。

sources.citation: The Land of the Elephant Kings (2018), via PeriodO: "First Period of Seleucid Political History" (311 – 281 BCE).
The Land of the Elephant Kings (2018), via PeriodO: "Second Period of Seleucid Political History" (281 – 223 BCE).
The Land of the Elephant Kings (2018), via PeriodO: "Third Period of Seleucid Political History" (223 – 164 BCE).
The Land of the Elephant Kings (2018), via PeriodO: "Fourth Period of Seleucid Political History" (164 – 64/63 BCE).

title.en: Seleucus I takes Babylon, the starting point of the Seleucid era
title.es: Seleuco I toma Babilonia, punto de partida de la era seléucida
title.zh: 塞琉古一世夺取巴比伦，这是塞琉古纪元的起点

sources.citation: World History Encyclopedia, "Seleucid Empire" (312 BCE: Seleucus conquers Babylon and founds the dynasty).
The Land of the Elephant Kings (2018), via PeriodO: "Seleucid Era" (312/311 BCE – 64 BCE).

note.en: Sources count the Seleucid era from 312 or 311 BCE.
note.es: Las fuentes cuentan la era seléucida desde 312 o 311 a. e. c.
note.zh: 各资料将塞琉古纪元定在公元前312年或311年。

title.en: Seleucus I and his allies defeat Antigonus I at Ipsus; Seleucus's war elephants block the enemy cavalry
title.es: Seleuco I y sus aliados derrotan a Antígono I en Ipso; los elefantes de guerra de Seleuco bloquean a la caballería enemiga
title.zh: 塞琉古一世及其盟友在伊普苏斯击败安提柯一世；塞琉古的战象挡住了敌方骑兵

sources.citation: Wikipedia, "Battle of Ipsus" (301 BC).
World History Encyclopedia, "Seleucid Empire" (301 BCE: victory at Ipsus).

title.en: Seleucus I founds Antioch on the Orontes, which becomes the Seleucid capital
title.es: Seleuco I funda Antioquía del Orontes, que se convierte en la capital seléucida
title.zh: 塞琉古一世建立奥龙特斯河畔的安条克，后成为塞琉古王朝的都城

sources.citation: Wikipedia, "Antioch" (founded between 301 and 299 BC).
World History Encyclopedia, "Seleucid Empire" (300 BCE: Seleucus founds Antioch on the Orontes).

name.zh: 奥龙特斯河畔的安条克（安塔基亚）

title.en: Parthia and Bactria break away from Seleucid rule
title.es: Partia y Bactria se separan del dominio seléucida
title.zh: 帕提亚和巴克特里亚脱离塞琉古统治

sources.citation: World History Encyclopedia, "Seleucid Empire" (Parthia revolts in 247 BCE; Diodotus of Bactria secedes).
Wikipedia, "Greco-Bactrian Kingdom" (Diodotus I's secession c. 255 or c. 246 BC).

note.en: Parthia's revolt is dated about 247 BCE. Historians date Diodotus's secession of Bactria to about 255 BCE (high chronology) or about 246 BCE (low chronology), and the question is not settled.
note.es: La rebelión de Partia se fecha hacia 247 a. e. c. Los historiadores datan la secesión de Bactria de Diodoto hacia 255 a. e. c. (cronología alta) o hacia 246 a. e. c. (cronología baja), y la cuestión no está resuelta.
note.zh: 帕提亚的叛离约在公元前247年。史家将狄奥多图斯使巴克特里亚独立的时间定在约公元前255年（高年表）或约前246年（低年表），尚无定论。

title.en: Rome defeats Antiochus III at Magnesia; the Treaty of Apamea strips the Seleucids of Anatolia west of the Taurus
title.es: Roma derrota a Antíoco III en Magnesia; el Tratado de Apamea priva a los seléucidas de Anatolia al oeste del Tauro
title.zh: 罗马在马格尼西亚击败安条克三世；《阿帕梅亚和约》使塞琉古失去托罗斯山以西的安纳托利亚

sources.citation: Wikipedia, "Battle of Magnesia" (December 190 or January 189 BC; Treaty of Apamea, 188 BC).
World History Encyclopedia, "Seleucid Empire" (190 BCE: Antiochus III defeated at Magnesia; 188 BCE: Treaty of Apamea).

name.zh: 西庇洛斯山下的马格尼西亚（马尼萨）

title.en: The Maccabees rise against Antiochus IV in Judea, take Jerusalem and rededicate the Temple
title.es: Los macabeos se alzan contra Antíoco IV en Judea, toman Jerusalén y reconsagran el Templo
title.zh: 马加比人在犹地亚起兵反抗安条克四世，攻占耶路撒冷并重新奉献圣殿

sources.citation: Wikipedia, "Maccabean Revolt" (uprising from 167 BCE; Temple rededicated 164 BCE).
World History Encyclopedia, "Maccabean Revolt" (167–160 BCE).

note.en: The main accounts are 1 and 2 Maccabees and Josephus, which favour the Maccabees. The wider revolt ran from 167 to 160 BCE.
note.es: Los relatos principales son 1 y 2 Macabeos y Flavio Josefo, que favorecen a los macabeos. La revuelta en sentido amplio duró de 167 a 160 a. e. c.
note.zh: 主要记载是《玛加伯上》《玛加伯下》和约瑟夫斯的著作，它们都偏向马加比人。整场起义从公元前167年持续到前160年。

title.en: Mithridates I of Parthia takes Babylonia from the Seleucids
title.es: Mitrídates I de Partia arrebata Babilonia a los seléucidas
title.zh: 帕提亚的米特里达梯一世从塞琉古人手中夺取巴比伦尼亚

sources.citation: Wikipedia, "Mithridates I of Parthia" (took Babylonia in 141 BC).
World History Encyclopedia, "Parthian Empire" (took Seleucia c. 144 BCE and Babylon in 141 BCE).

name.zh: 底格里斯河畔的塞琉西亚

title.en: Pompey removes Antiochus XIII and makes Syria a Roman province, ending Seleucid rule
title.es: Pompeyo depone a Antíoco XIII y convierte Siria en provincia romana, poniendo fin al dominio seléucida
title.zh: 庞培废黜安条克十三世，将叙利亚设为罗马行省，塞琉古统治就此终结

sources.citation: Wikipedia, "Antiochus XIII Asiaticus" (Pompey ended his rule in 64 BC).
World History Encyclopedia, "Seleucid Empire" (63 BCE: Pompey makes Syria and Anatolia Roman provinces).

note.en: Sources date the end to 64 or 63 BCE.
note.es: Las fuentes datan el final en 64 o 63 a. e. c.
note.zh: 各资料将终结定在公元前64年或63年。

text.en: Ancient writers say Seleucus I gave Chandragupta Maurya lands in the east in return for 500 war elephants.
text.es: Los autores antiguos dicen que Seleuco I cedió a Chandragupta Maurya tierras del este a cambio de 500 elefantes de guerra.
text.zh: 古代作家称，塞琉古一世把东部的土地让给旃陀罗笈多·孔雀，换取500头战象。

sources.citation: Wikipedia, "Seleucid–Mauryan war" (305–303 BCE; Strabo; no Indian source records the exchange).
